rootCauses.missingAcknowledgments: The previous layer inferred transitions only by comparing lastKey inside enhance(). On the first post-action render lastKey was often unset or initialized after the state was already advanced, and the toast was appended to document.body instead of the active rerendered workspace. The corrected layer listens to the actual inherited modal confirmation button (#index272-modal-host [data-index272-confirm]), waits until the canonical action advances lifecycle state and rerenders, then inserts the status node into the active current-step panel.
rootCauses.inheritedModalActive: The previous layer assigned window.i272Modal, but the existing button handler closes over the lexical i272Modal function defined in the inherited script. Reassigning window.i272Modal did not change that lexical reference, so the inherited modal continued to open. The corrected layer rebinds the live data-i272-confirm button after each rerender to call openIndex275AccountabilityModal directly after i272Sync validation.
